status: offline startup and SMMU ownership audit for v66

linked_ios26_startup_objects.observed_behavior: Validates the selected K80 root identity and stages ZornRootStartup26::RootInputs. It does not prepare the GPU board stage or construct ZornGen7StartupGpuInputs26.
Accepts an already-constructed ZornGen7StartupGpuInputs26 and forwards it to ZornGen7StartupOwner26. It validates ownership references but does not create callbacks or numeric authority values.

available_but_unselected_direct_bridge.observed_behavior: Has a stage-specific direct schedule bridge for caller-supplied GPU inputs. It does not instantiate the input owner.

candidate_smmu_owners.observed_behavior: Retains page descriptors and mappings and separates never-installed retirement from post-context-use retirement.
Owns prepared host/process tables, process ASID bookkeeping and VM attachment under its retained gate.
Implements serialized kernel-owned BO mapping transactions; comments require an independent all-master quiesce lease and the class is not an OS-published runtime by itself.

conclusion.next_step: Implement a concrete GPU/GMU exclusion owner backed by actual K80 provider/resource lifetimes, then connect it and the existing SMMU owner to the maintained root startup path. Preserve the fixed Recovery watchdog.
